answer: Every participant posts 20 POA for ten epochs and must finish four distinct jobs, each checked by three randomly chosen reviewers with no shared funder. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed fakery burns 12% of the bond. The record is public: a nadir in reputation blocks premium tasks until recovery, a glacier of slow verified tenure proves real work, and a pigment of reused evidence exposes copied submissions. Each added sybil identity needs its own bond, jobs, and reviewers, so farming costs more than honest labour.
